caption:
How do you take a before-and-after photo you can actually trust?
Fix four things, and take it yourself.

You cannot control how a clinic photographs you. You can control light, distance, expression and time of day - and those four are most of the difference between two photographs of the same face.

A mathematical model of short-distance photography shows the nose appears larger at typical selfie range than at portrait range. The model describes geometry, not your face, so it cannot say how much your own features shift. It says the shift is real, predictable, and that it disappears with distance.

Tonight: one window, arm fully out, relaxed face, three angles. Then leave it alone for a few weeks. Change is slower than attention.

General education only.

#BeforeAndAfter #SkinTracking #KoreanAesthetics #MedicalAesthetics #BetterDecisions
first_comment: Most people take the after and never took the before. If you are considering anything at all this year, tonight is the cheapest thing you can do about it. Which angle do you always forget?
